verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items are SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO certification, the claim that data stays on monday's servers, and admin auditing of agent actions, but these are adjacent security controls, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
